title: Inverse Galois Problem
description: Asks if all finite groups appear as Galois groups over rationals.

title: Jacobian Conjecture
description: Asks if polynomial maps with constant nonzero Jacobian determinant are invertible.

title: Andrews-Curtis Conjecture
description: Proposes that all balanced presentations of the trivial group are equivalent.

title: Congruence Subgroup Problem
description: Asks if all finite index subgroups contain a principal congruence subgroup.

title: Kaplansky Unit Conjecture
description: Hypothesizes that group rings of torsion-free groups have only trivial units.
